answer_1.quote: We conduct comprehensive experiments on general benchmark SpecBench , and specialized dataset on code domain, MBPP with Vicuna and Code Llama .

answer_2.quote: The following evaluation metrics are used: Mean Accepted Token (MAT) represents the average number of tokens confirmed in a single decoding step; Tokens per Second (Ts/s) measures the number of tokens processed per second; Speedup ratio compares the performance relative to HuggingFace's implementation of AR decoding.
